lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr12Cu8Ge4 (reduced formula Sr3Cu2Ge) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements: each Cu and Ge center has 8 Sr neighbors, while each Sr center has 4 Cu and 4 Ge neighbors, all at 3.2457 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 24 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and face-sharing between Cu and Sr polyhedra, corner-sharing between Ge and Sr polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Cu and Ge polyhedra.
